channel.title: Controller CRDs on Open Component Model
channel.description: Recent content in Controller CRDs on Open Component Model

item.title: Repository
item.description: A Repository represents an OCM repository (for example, an OCI registry) that contains component versions. The controller validates the repository at the configured interval and propagates OCM configuration.

item.title: Component
item.description: A Component represents an OCM component version to be tracked by the controller. It references a Repository object and specifies a semantic version constraint to select which component version to reconcile.

item.title: Resource
item.description: A Resource represents a specific OCM resource (artifact) within a component version. It references a Component object and identifies the desired resource by name and identity.

item.title: Deployer
item.description: A Deployer is a cluster-scoped resource that deploys OCM resources into the cluster. It references a Resource containing a ResourceGroupDefinition and manages the lifecycle of the deployed Kubernetes objects.

item.title: NamespacedDeployer
item.description: A NamespacedDeployer is a namespaced resource that deploys OCM resources. It references a Resource in the same namespace and applies and prunes the deployed objects with the permissions of the service account in spec.serviceAccountName, so that service account’s RBAC decides what it may deploy. If spec.serviceAccountName is empty, it impersonates the default service account of its namespace. It never applies with the controller’s own permissions.

item.title: Replication
item.description: A Replication transfers a component version from one OCM repository to another, the same behaviour of ocm transfer as a controller. It references a Component for the source version and a target Repository, and re-runs the transfer whenever the resolved source version changes.

item.title: Discovery
item.description: A Discovery publishes a filtered, optionally projected view of the transitive reference graph of a Component. It resolves the entire reachable graph from the Component’s resolved repository, applies reference, component, and resource selectors, and either publishes the filtered raw v2 descriptors or projects them into free-form records with CEL expressions.
